title: Section 422.12 – Add an Informational Note at the end of “Exception No. 2” in Section 422.12 to read as follows:
officialText:
Informational Note: For Safety, Controls, and Electrical requirement for Low-Pressure Steam-Heating Boiler and
Low-Pressure Hot-Water Heating Boiler, see New York City Mechanical Code, Chapter 10, “Safety and Pressure
Relief Valves and Controls”. For definition of Low-Pressure Hot Water Heating Boiler and Low-Pressure Steam-
Heating Boiler refer to the New York City Mechanical Code.
